info.name: Wiktionary MediaWiki Core REST Definition API

params.name: term
params.description: The dictionary term (URL-encoded; case-sensitive on Wiktionary).

params.name: redirect
params.description: Whether to follow page redirects (defaults to true).

items.docs: Return a multilingual structured definition for a term, broken down by source language code (en, fr, de, …) and then by part of speech. Wiktionary-specific endpoint built on top of Parsoid parsing.
